test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
What will come at the place of (?)

QUIXOTIC : IDEALISTIC :: PRAGMATIC : ?
solution: The logic followed here is : **"Quixotic"** means **"Idealistic"** or extremely impractical and imaginative. Similarly, **"Pragmatic"** means **"Realistic"** or practical in approach. Hence, the correct answer is **"option (1)"**.
